title: Data editor
description: Browse and edit table rows, and issue API keys for your applications.
prompt: Enter a database and a table to get started.

workspace.description: Select a workspace to edit data.
workspace.loadingDescription: Fetching the workspaces available to the active organization.
workspace.denied: This organization has no workspaces yet. Ask an organization or workspace owner or administrator to create the first one.

rows.title: Rows
rows.emptyDescription: Insert the first row with the form below.

insert.title: Insert row
insert.description: Create a new row from a JSON object.
insert.label: New row (JSON)

deleteConfirm.title: Delete row
deleteConfirm.consequence1: The row disappears from the table.
deleteConfirm.consequence2: There is no action to recover it.

confirm.instruction: The button unlocks when the text matches exactly.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Issue anon or service keys for your applications and revoke them when they are no longer used.
keys.empty: There are no API keys yet.
keys.emptyDescription: Issue an anon or service key with the buttons above.
keys.revokeConsequence1: Applications that use it stop working.
keys.revokeConsequence2: A revoked key cannot be restored.
keys.revealDescription: Use this key in your applications with the apikey header.
keys.once: Copy this key now; it will not be shown again.
keys.previewCount: Preview with this key: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}.
keys.previewTable: Preview rows with the issued key

noAccessDescription.rows: You do not have permission to view the rows of this table.
noAccessDescription.keys: You do not have permission to view the API keys of this workspace.
noAccessDescription.workspace: You do not have permission to view the workspaces.

notFoundDescription: The database, schema or table you entered does not exist in this workspace.

errors.keys: API keys could not be loaded

serverError: The server could not complete the request. Try again.
networkError: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errorTitle: The action could not be completed
missingKeyEdit: The row has no primary key "id" to edit it
missingKeyDelete: The row has no primary key "id" to delete it

editDrawer.title: Edit row {id}
editDrawer.description: Change the row fields. The id primary key is not sent.
editDrawer.label: Row (JSON)
